title: Death at Ravenscroft Manor
story:
Rain has hammered Ravenscroft Manor since dusk, and at half past eight the storm took the telephone line with it. At ten o'clock the cook found Lord Ravenscroft dead on the conservatory floor.

Hobbs, the butler, made his rounds every fifteen minutes from nine o'clock on. On each round he passed exactly one guest: alone, in a different room each time, and holding something they had no business carrying. Hobbs remembers every detail. He just can't put them in order.

Work out where each guest was, what they were holding, and when Hobbs saw them. Whoever he passed in the Conservatory is your killer.
clues: Dr. Pryce was not seen at 9:45 PM.
The guest holding the poison vial was not Dr. Pryce.
Dr. Pryce was not seen at 9:30 PM.
The guest holding the letter opener was seen earlier than the guest in the Library.
The guest in the Conservatory was seen exactly fifteen minutes before the guest in the Wine Cellar.
The guest Hobbs saw at 9:15 PM was not holding the poison vial.
Colonel Ashby was not in the Conservatory.
Of the guest in the Wine Cellar and the guest in the Billiard Room, one was Miss Thorne and the other was Dr. Pryce.
Of the guest holding the poison vial and the guest holding the candlestick, one was Lady Vane and the other was Dr. Pryce.
epilogue: It was Lady Vane. Lord Ravenscroft never left the Conservatory that evening, and at 9:00 PM Hobbs walked straight past Lady Vane at his lordship's side, poison vial in hand. Hobbs thought nothing of it at the time. He thinks about little else now.
